# feat(preview): signed, short-lived preview tokens per site and the preview URL service

<!-- bogd3v/micelio-plugin-core#44 as read with gh issue view on 2026-10-24: the input of micelio-plugin-core-44.md -->

Part of #62.

## Why

The preview renders drafts on the frontend, which only serves published content to the public. The admin needs a way to ask the frontend for a draft that cannot be guessed, forwarded or kept (ADR-0019, section "Authorisation"; ADR-0003 for drafts).

## What to build

- `server/src/services/preview.ts`: `previewUrl({ site, uid, documentId, locale, mode })` returns the frontend URL of the draft with a token: HMAC over site, uid, documentId, locale, mode and expiry (15 minutes), key from `MICELIO_PREVIEW_SECRET` (required in production, generated and warned about in development), encoded as `?__preview=<token>`; `mode` is `dynamic` or `static` (decision 8).
- `GET /micelio/preview-url?uid&documentId&locale&mode` (admin router, permission `plugin::micelio.preview`) answers `{ data: { url, expiresAt } }`; a document of a site the admin may not edit → `403` `previewForbidden`.
- `docs/api.md`, `docs/operate/preview.md` (how the frontend verifies: shared secret, clock skew tolerance 60 s), `.env.example`.

## Requirements

- The token names one document and one mode and expires; it carries no content and never appears in logs.
- Per site: the URL uses the site's first host; a site without a frontend origin answers `previewUnavailable`.
- `feat` → MINOR; one new required variable in production is announced in the release notes (an operator action, see section 7 before 1.0.0).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Unit tests: a token verifies with the right secret and fails with a wrong one, after expiry, or with another documentId.
- [ ] Integration: the route answers for the default site and refuses a site the role cannot edit.
- [ ] Boot in production without the secret stops with a message that names it (standard, section 5).
- [ ] Verified by the maintainer on the plugin's Docker Compose (`compose.dev.yml`: clean Strapi with the plugin, PostgreSQL and the frontend image), following the steps the PR lists under Tests.

## Progress

Not started.

## Delivery

The agent never pushes on its own. When the maintainer says the manual test on Docker is done, the agent gives the `git add` and `git commit -s` commands with the message (conventional prefix, English, `Co-Authored-By:` trailer); once the maintainer confirms the commit, the agent pushes the branch and opens the PR (REST), with the Docker steps under Tests and `Refs`/`Closes` to this issue. The maintainer reviews the whole diff before merging (standard, sections 11 and 13).
